name: og-learnbot
description: LearnBOT monorepo: Next.js Frontend + Flask Backend

scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && npm run dev:apps
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow npm:dev:web npm:dev:api npm:dev:worker
scripts.infra:reset: bash scripts/docker.sh compose down -v && npm run infra:up
scripts.setup:app: cd Backend && uv venv --python 3.13 .venv-app && uv pip install --python .venv-app/bin/python -r requirements-app.txt
